intent: Mark a scope transition from data rendering into unauthorized execution at the worker boundary. The crossing is the focal change, with commands and outputs remaining unreadable.
source:
**Location:** `huggingface-dataset-processor`

**Frame:** The dataset processor crosses from `RENDER DATA` to an unauthorized `EXECUTE` state. No command or output is readable.

**Action:** Attacker-controlled metadata reaches the operating-system command boundary.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> THE WORKER TREATS PART OF THE SUPPLIED DATA DESCRIPTION AS INSTRUCTIONS TO RUN. ANOTHER FLAW CROSSES THE LINE FROM READING TO EXECUTION.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `compressed` — vulnerability effect from `OAI-TR` and `HF-TL`; mechanics omitted.
title: Rendering crosses into unauthorized execution
